connectionMethod: RSS feed — https://{city}.craigslist.org/search/{category}?format=rss&query={keywords}; categories ggg/tlg/evg/crg/jjj; poll only RSS, never scrape HTML, gentle cadence
name: Craigslist RSS
provides: Gigs, talent gigs, event gigs, creative gigs, jobs — rawest, fastest local casting/gig posts; title, posting URL, location, date posted, compensation (often in title/body), category
tosStatus: TENSION: Terms of Use prohibit automated access/copying, but RSS is a machine-readable output Craigslist itself offers on search pages. Poll RSS only, low volume, respect blocks immediately. ToS re-check required before 50-state scale-up.
updateFrequency: Real-time — new posts appear the moment they are published
verificationBasis: Proven in-house: Craigslist gig auto-contact scanner fetched Miami crg/evg/tlg searches since 26 Oct 2026, storing real JSON records. Last run 4 Nov 2026 — idle 17 days at research time.

connectionMethod: Public HTML + sitemap (allcasting.com/sitemap.xml); location-filtered public pages; gentle daily reads
name: AllCasting
provides: Casting calls and open auditions: acting, modeling, reality TV, theater, music videos, extras, commercials; title, location, expiry date on every listing, rate/pay, role count, categories, age/gender filters
tosStatus: robots.txt read live 2026-11-21: User-agent: * Allow: / with only /api/* and /talent/api/* disallowed — most permissive of any board checked. Terms of Use NOT read — verify the no-scraping clause before automating.
verificationBasis: Search results + live robots.txt read 2026-11-21; ~200-266 active calls / ~480-730 roles at checks on 21 Nov 2026; Florida pages verified live (Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville).

connectionMethod: Public HTML + sitemap (projectcasting.com/sitemap_index.xml); crawl sitemap for job pages, do NOT fetch disallowed filtered-search URLs; free email newsletter as zero-code ingestion path

tosStatus: robots.txt read live 2026-11-21: base listing pages allowed; /jobs?*& and /professionals?*& disallowed. It republishes from other sources — every listing must be traced to its ORIGINAL source before it counts as verified.
updateFrequency: Multiple new calls daily; site says updated daily
verificationBasis: Search results + live robots.txt read 2026-11-21; verified live: Miami background-extras call ($200/8 hrs), Miami Vice '85 casting guide, STARZ rodeo series background.

connectionMethod: Google's own service — email delivery to owner Gmail or RSS delivery per alert; suggested alerts: "casting call" Miami, "extras" Miami casting, "filming in Miami" casting, "background actors" Florida, "open casting call" Florida, "now casting" Miami
name: Google Alerts
provides: Email/RSS whenever Google indexes a new page matching a keyword: production announcements, casting calls on blogs/local news, film-office posts. Pointer only (title, excerpt, link) — the linked page must then be read and extracted.
tosStatus: Fully compliant — it is Google's own service. No scraping involved.
updateFrequency: As-it-happens, daily, or weekly digest (owner's choice)
verificationBasis: Google's own support page checked 2026-11-21: free since 2003, unlimited keywords.

connectionMethod: Public HTML + sitemap; operator/manual review of public pages, or Google-index discovery; full submission instructions are behind membership — never bypass the login wall
name: Backstage
provides: Largest volume of open casting calls: film, TV, theater, commercials, music videos, voiceover, modeling, UGC; pay, location, dates, roles, expiry, company details, casting-director name + jobs-posted count visible without login
tosStatus: robots.txt read live 2026-11-21: listing pages NOT disallowed (/casting/... open); /search/, /account/*, /subscribe/* disallowed. Terms of Use NOT read and almost certainly prohibit automated scraping — DO NOT automate until ToS is read and a compliant approach is agreed.
verificationBasis: Search results + live robots.txt read 2026-11-21; 2,870-4,814 jobs per major-city page; Miami listings verified live (Latin-artist music video $150-$250). Applying requires membership (~$25/month or $99.99/6 months per App Store listing — verify current price).

connectionMethod: FREE ACCOUNT + HUMAN OPERATOR READS ONLY. No public page to fetch — everything is behind login. Free Starter account: browse ALL breakdowns, 2 photos, 1 SlateShot, resume, Role Match notifications; manual entry into TOP TEA TALENTS (the manual step IS the verification step)

updateFrequency: Daily, real-time as casting offices post
verificationBasis: Multiple independent reviews verified Nov 2026 confirm: profile free, browsing free, free Starter submits name + resume only.

connectionMethod: FREE ACCOUNT + HUMAN OPERATOR, plus search-index discovery (Google-indexed project pages readable without login). No API, no RSS. Do not automate a logged-in session.

verificationBasis: Search results verified live 2026-11-21: Miami GTA in-house project page indexed ($200-$500/day, background extras); Casting Networks support page confirms free membership browses the Casting Billboard.

connectionMethod: MANUAL/OPERATOR: website + Facebook + Instagram checks; no RSS, no API. Relationship source — register talent with them (free) and watch their channels
name: Casting TaylorMade

verificationBasis: Search results verified live 2026-11-21: their own posts + Project Casting Miami Vice guide + Easy 93.1 Miami radio.
